items.title: Product of the Day — Money Laundry Machine
items.text:
The Money Laundry Machine is a high-tech appliance designed to cleanse financial documents of their original intent. Feed in a stack of invoices, receipts, and bank statements, and this machine will neutralize any evidence of purchases, transactions, or investments. The resulting output appears identical yet contains contradictory information, perfect for befuddling auditors and creditors alike.

When operated correctly, the machine hums softly, emitting a faint scent reminiscent of freshly laundered socks. Excess lint generated during processing collects within an easily removable compartment labeled 'Lost Income'.

items.title: Product of the Day — A Stuffed Penguin That Eats Pictures Of Cheeseburgers
items.text:
This plush penguin has been engineered to consume photographic representations of cheeseburger meals rather than traditional sustenance. Its small intestine contains specialized enzymes capable of breaking down pixels into nutritional compounds indistinguishable from real meat byproducts. Due to its voracious appetite, owners may find themselves perpetually snapping images of their favorite fast-food joints to satiate the creature's demands.

As the penguin grows accustomed to its diet, it will gradually transform into various forms resembling historical depictions of anthropomorphic rodents serving burgers. This metamorphosis serves no practical purpose other than aesthetic appeal; nonetheless, enthusiasts have come to cherish these bizarre transformations as cherished heirlooms within dedicated enthusiast communities.

Categories: creatures
